# Aggregate web mode does not open a local store, so ambient selectors do not
# participate in its selector validation.
env CARDAMOM_STORE=$WORK/missing-store
env CARDAMOM_BOARD=missing-board

[!assets] ! exec card web --no-browser --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1
[!assets] ! stdout .
[!assets] stderr 'embedded web assets: web assets not found'
[!assets] ! stderr 'cannot be combined with --store or --board'

[assets] exec sh probe-aggregate-web.sh
[assets] cmp stdout $WORK/golden/aggregate-probe.txt

# Explicit selectors remain incompatible with aggregate web mode.
! exec card --store $WORK/explicit-store web --no-browser --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1
! stdout .
stderr 'web: --source cannot be combined with --store or --board'

! exec card --board explicit-board web --no-browser --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1
! stdout .
stderr 'web: --source cannot be combined with --store or --board'

-- probe-aggregate-web.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

card web --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --no-browser \
  --source primary=http://127.0.0.1:1 >web.out 2>web.err &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  if grep -q '^web application available at ' web.out; then
    kill -TERM "$pid"
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    trap - EXIT
    echo 'aggregate web probe passed'
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done

cat web.err >&2
exit 1

-- golden/aggregate-probe.txt --
aggregate web probe passed
